title: 4xB300 cross-framework (latest-vs-latest)
description: Cross-framework round on one RunPod 4xB300 box (x86 host): 16 cases, SGLang-Diffusion against vLLM-Omni, LightX2V, TRT-LLM VisualGen, ComfyUI and FastVideo. The sglang cells ran this round's sglang fix/perf trees (main plus the then-open PRs, listed under frameworks.sglang); every one of those PRs is on main as of 2026-10-29 except sgl-project/sglang#46100. Video cells come from the 2026-10-24 encode-aligned pass: every configurable framework encodes the MP4 like the closest competitor. LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 are retired after this round and keep their rows; their successor LTX-2.5 has no row here (its result files were lost with the box).

hardware.machine: rx devbox b300r1022 (RunPod), one box for every cell
hardware.gpus: 4x NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC 275040 MiB, 1100 W cap

harness_commits.850052ac9: reruns b300img1022r / b300vid1022r (TRT-LLM H3 throughput after the multipart fix, LTX-2.3 vLLM-Omni)
harness_commits.bcb659a60: competitor fixes b300*1022s and the sglang preview-tree pass b300*1022p

frameworks.sglang: Per cell. Image cells, LTX-2, LTX-2.3 (pass b300*1022p) and MiniMax-H3 t2va / 4-GPU / ref2va (enc1024 sgl-stack): 3042cea843 = main 1e894eb92d + sgl-project/sglang#45965 #45977 #46045 #46046 #46047 #46099 #46100 #46101 #46102 #46105-#46111 #46145-#46149. Cosmos3 T2V / I2V: e52f28491c = 3042cea843 + #46171-#46174 + a threaded condition-image resize that was never opened as a PR (I2V only, -43 ms). Wan2.2: 4be217383f = main 1e894eb92d + this round's Wan stack (it went in through #46145-#46149, #46171, #46174, #46227, #46228 and #46247, which carries #46244-#46246). FastH3: main 82f7249ce6 (matrix pass; not re-measured, by decision). Every PR named here is merged as of 2026-10-29 except #46100 (conditioning-cache parallel hashing; Qwen image cells). #46149 merged with its VAE channels_last restricted to the decoder, so the Cosmos3 I2V cell's VAE encoder differs from main.

merge.rule: build_report_artifacts: a later input replaces an earlier one per (case_id, framework)

replaced.sglang (image cells, LTX-2, LTX-2.3): b300img1022p (preview tree 3042cea843) replaces the matrix pass (main 82f7249ce6), the r/s reruns and the main 02b98360 pass (b300*1022m, kept out of the merge).
replaced.sglang (video cells except FastH3): enc1024 sgl-stack replaces every earlier pass; its sgl-main and sgl-stack-before arms are A/B controls and stay out of the merge. Where an arm ran twice, the second round is published for every framework in the cell.
replaced.video competitors: enc1024 replaces vLLM-Omni (Wan2.2, Cosmos3 T2V/I2V, H3 x3), LightX2V (H3 x3), TRT-LLM (Wan2.2, Cosmos3 T2V) and ComfyUI (Wan2.2). TRT-LLM and LightX2V hard-code x264 medium/CRF 23, so their other video cells stand.
replaced.TRT-LLM MiniMax-H3: b300vid1022s (OMP_NUM_THREADS=8; FA4 for 4-GPU and ref2va) replaces the matrix pass: t2va 74.45 -> 69.60 s, 4-GPU 63.23 -> 37.79 s, ref2va 163.56 -> 106.92 s (the matrix ref2va ran masked SDPA after Ulysses padded an odd sequence).
replaced.LightX2V Qwen-Image-2.1, Wan2.2, Cosmos3: b300*1022s (torch_sdpa) replaces the matrix pass (Qwen 3.02 -> 2.56 s, Wan2.2 241.6 -> 100.3 s).
replaced.vLLM-Omni LTX-2 / LTX-2.3: b300img1022s (VAE patch parallel) replaces the matrix and r passes.

merge.last_input: run_enc1024_h3_sgl-stack_r1 is listed last so the run-level sglang version (taken from the last input) names 3042cea843, the tree behind 12 of the 16 sglang cells; no other input carries its (case, framework).

files.raw/: original runner output; exactly the merge inputs above
files.merged.json: merged artifact the Pages data was published from
files.issue.md: data-only tracker report with per-cell statuses and reasons
